policies.full: No overload reduction; stop at thinking safety cap if necessary
policies.arrival: Choose 2048 if latest observed engine waiting queue has >=2 requests at arrival; otherwise 16384; never update after arrival
policies.live: Same arrival rule, plus irreversible reduction of active thinking requests to 2048 whenever observed engine queue has >=2 waiting

pressure: Atomic post-schedule queue snapshot, published every engine step; phase-scoped; ages and queue IDs logged
calibration: Two full-thinking concurrent requests, indices 0 and 2. Freeze burst at 0.25*min(completion latencies), relative deadline at 2*max(completion latencies).
arrivals: Indices 0 and 1 at time zero; indices 2..11 at burst_at + (index-2)*0.05 seconds
transition: Exact Stage 3 14-token cue, budget counts generated tokens before cue; no cue for full safety-cap failures
timing: Completion measured from scheduled arrival, includes injection lag and queueing; actual server arrival and worker admission also recorded
primary: Correct normal completion within per-request frozen relative deadline; count and count/fixed observation horizon
grading: Existing canonical + math-verify 0.9.0; extraction ambiguities reviewed; cap stops count as failures
continuation_screen: At least one genuine live intervention; more correct on-time completions than both baselines; no fewer completed-correct than full on this trace
limits: One allocation <=60 minutes; <=36 measured +2 calibration attempts; no array, repeats, automatic retries, or tuning after outcomes
interpretation: Development pilot, one trace and one seed per problem; cannot establish a 3pp quality floor or a population serving improvement
